exams.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា

questions.label: a
questions.technique: No indeterminate form: sqrt(3x^2-11) is continuous at x=3 and 3(3)^2-11=16≥0, so evaluate by direct substitution.

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=pi/3. Substitute t=x-pi/3 so the denominator is -t; apply the standard sinc limit sin t/t → 1 with a sign flip.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: ∞-∞ growth-rate comparison. Factor out x: x(2-7/x-11 ln x/x). As x→∞, ln x/x → 0, so the bracket → 2, and x·2 → +∞; linear growth always beats logarithmic growth.
